text: girl in the library next to me spent the whole afternoon setting up. new notion template. highlighters lined up by shade. printed all 40 pdfs. then started the apa reference list by hand. no zotero. no semantic scholar. no jenni. wrote one sentence at 4pm and packed up. Curating a museum of not writing
base_video: Creator sat on a sofa with a mug, slowly rolling their eyes and looking off camera, then back to lens with a flat unimpressed face.
audio: original audio, room tone with kettle in the background
caption: the setup was the dissertation. tell me im wrong
why_this_brand: Jenni sits in the list beside Zotero and Semantic Scholar as the ordinary thing a researcher would already have open while everyone else builds a shrine of tabs, printouts and hand-typed APA.
what_changed: Softened the tally to 'two of them existed' and moved 'no jenni' to the end of the no-list beside 'no library database'.

format.reason: Jenni is a SaaS workspace with a painfully relatable old way: 40 PDF tabs at 1am and hand-reformatting APA to Harvard the night before submission, which a silent reacting academic plus one text block lands instantly without needing demo footage. The product benefit (every claim traced to a real source) is discovered as the punchline of the text, not announced, which keeps it native to academic TikTok.
format.why_not_runner_up: It needs real screen-capture demo footage of the citation and Reviews flow that the brand has not supplied, and a first awareness post should sell the pain, not the interface.

editor_fix: soften the invented tally to 'two of them existed' reads fine, but make the no-list land harder by moving 'no jenni' to sit beside 'no library database' rather than leading it.
